text:
I am gentle and sad if I adore, I can

bring heaven down to my hand when

I entangle another's soul with mine.

You will find no down softer.


No one like me kisses hands,

nor crouches so much in a dream,

nor did there fit in another body, so small,

a human soul of greater tenderness.


I die upon the eyes, if I feel them

like living birds, for a moment,

flutter beneath my white fingers.


I know the phrase that enchants and understands

and I know how to be silent when the moon ascends

enormous and red over the ravines.

translation.title: I Am
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the tender self-portrait and the closing discipline of silence.
